Paths
/worker/v1 and /state/v1 go to the ALB; signed object URLs point at S3 directly. The runner's scenarios and all three clusters use the same public origin.

div.div:
Trust anchors and egress
Pods and the runner trust system roots: the public certificates of the lab domain and S3. EKS reaches the ALB inside AWS; AKS and GKE egress through their NAT to it.

div.div:
Against
Largest scope and cost: a server root with database, store, load balancer, DNS and certificate per batch. The server runs remotely, so its coverage needs its own collection. Slowest to provision and clean up.
